As a Physician with UCLA Health, UCan enjoy the close connection of community-focused patient care with the resources and reputation of one of the nation’s leading health systems. We have openings for
board certified/eligible Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, and Med-Peds physicians within West Los Angeles
to view an extensive list of our clinics.
Provide both acute and convenience care to members of the local community
Utilize your full breadth of clinical skills to treat a diverse patient population
Collaborate with some of the world’s top physicians and researchers at the David Geffen School of Medicine
Work within a highly-innovative practice environment, including Epic Systems
Discover tremendous professional rewards with one of Forbes’ “Best In-State Employers”
Enjoy an excellent salary, incentive and benefits program
Experience California’s incredible variety of lifestyle advantages with our more than 280 locations

Must be comfortable working with patients of all ages

The South Bay offers a perfect blend of coastal living, outdoor adventure, and urban convenience. From the stunning oceanfront cliffs of Palos Verdes to the lively beach communities of Manhattan Beach, Redondo Beach, and Torrance, this region is known for its relaxed atmosphere and breathtaking scenery. Residents enjoy top-rated schools, excellent dining, boutique shopping, and endless outdoor activities, including surfing, hiking, and biking along The Strand. Whether you prefer the quiet elegance of Palos Verdes or the vibrant energy of the coastal cities, the South Bay provides an exceptional quality of life with easy access to Los Angeles and beyond.
